set_aside.subject: authenticate_service_principal transaction requirements
set_aside.text: authenticate_service_principal: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST open its transaction with an explicit assignment, never as a context manager, reach principal and credential persistence only through the service_identity repository of that transaction, use no legacy transaction-level service method, and close the transaction exactly once. It writes nothing, so it closes the transaction with exactly one rollback of that transaction after its last read and never commits; a failure rolls back only while the local open flag still marks the transaction open.
set_aside.question: PortalTransaction and its service_identity, rollback and commit operations must be restored to the imported contract surface, or this transaction requirement must change.
set_aside.set_aside_because: an unchanged passage of a unit reviewed for its change
